promise_band.headline: You Get The Number In Writing
promise_band.body: The most common complaint about lawn and landscape work around here is not the price — it is the contractor who quotes verbally, starts late, and hands over a bigger invoice than anybody discussed. We do the opposite. We come out, look at the property, and send you the scope and the price in writing. If we say Tuesday, we are there Tuesday. If the weather turns, we tell you rather than going quiet. That is why most of our work now comes from neighbours of people we have already worked for.

signature_system.headline: Straight Answers, Then Straight To Work
signature_system.intro: Whether it is a weekly mow, a paver patio, or a season of plowing a commercial lot, every Bilski's job runs the same way — quoted in writing, scheduled properly, and cleaned up before we leave.

blocks.title: We solve the drainage, not just the surface
blocks.body: A lot of yard problems in this area are water problems. We install underground downspout extensions, drains, and graded beds so the erosion actually stops — instead of re-seeding the same washed-out patch every spring.

blocks.title: Residential and commercial, same standard
blocks.body: We maintain private properties and commercial accounts side by side, including full-winter snow and ice coverage for parking lots and sidewalks. The crew, the equipment and the response time are the same either way.

signature_system.steps_title: Clean-up is part of the job, not an afterthought

steps.title: Beds edged and defined
steps.body: Crisp edges cut in before the mulch goes down, not scuffed in afterwards.

steps.title: Clippings and debris hauled out
steps.body: Nothing left bagged at the kerb for you to deal with.

steps.title: Hard surfaces blown clean
steps.body: Drive, walks and patio cleared before we load the trailer.

guarantee.title: If it isn't right, we come back
guarantee.body: We would rather return and fix something than have you living with work you are not happy with. Tell us what is off and we will put it right — that is how a business built on neighbourhood referrals has to operate.

about_block.headline: Started In 2020, Grown By Referral
about_block.body: Bilski's Lawn Care started in the summer of 2020, in the middle of the Covid shutdowns, with a simple goal — give Luzerne County a landscaping company that answers the phone and does what it said it would. Ryan and the crew began with mowing and mulch installs. Six seasons later we are building paver patios and retaining walls, solving drainage problems, and holding commercial snow contracts through the winter — with a 4.9-star rating across 40 reviews to show for it.

seo_body.headline: Lawn Care & Landscaping In Wilkes-Barre
paragraphs: Northeastern Pennsylvania is a demanding place to keep a property. Heavy spring rain washes out beds and undermines walls, the summer runs humid enough to push weeds through mulch in weeks, autumn drops leaves faster than most homeowners can keep up with, and winter arrives with the ice and plow work that closes commercial lots.

We work that whole calendar — weekly and bi-weekly mowing, hedge trimming, spring and autumn clean-ups, mulch and planting-bed installs, paver patios and segmental retaining walls, drainage and downspout work, and commercial snow and ice management from the first storm to the last.

Bilski's serves Wilkes-Barre, Kingston, Plains, Hanover, Wyoming, Pittston, Ashley, Luzerne, Mountain Top, Nanticoke, Exeter, White Haven, Alden, Laurel Run, Scranton, Plymouth, Bear Creek and Freeland. If you are near one of those and not sure whether we reach you, call and ask — the answer is usually yes.

Mulch installs, planting beds and hedge trimming
Paver patios, retaining walls and drainage solutions
Commercial snow removal for lots and sidewalks

faqs.q: How do I get a quote?
faqs.a: Call (570) 899-6400 or send a message through the site. We come out, look at the property, and send you the scope and price in writing — free, and with no obligation.

faqs.q: Do you do one-off jobs or only seasonal contracts?
faqs.a: Both. Plenty of customers book us for a single spring clean-up, a mulch install, or one patio. Others are on weekly or bi-weekly mowing for the whole season. Either is fine.

faqs.q: How often will you mow my lawn?
faqs.a: Weekly is standard through the growing season, with bi-weekly available on slower-growing properties. We agree the schedule up front so you know which day to expect us.

faqs.q: Can you fix a drainage or erosion problem?
faqs.a: Yes, and it is a good part of what we do. Underground downspout extensions, drains, re-grading and bed correction — we sort out where the water is actually going rather than re-seeding the same damage every year.

faqs.q: Do you build patios and retaining walls?
faqs.a: Yes. Paver patios, walkways and segmental block retaining walls, including the base preparation and drainage behind the wall that decides whether it stays straight.

faqs.q: Do you take commercial snow removal accounts?
faqs.a: Yes. We plow and treat commercial parking lots and clear sidewalks through the winter. Get in touch before the season to lock in coverage.
